Predictions.Transcription: Supervised learning is when a given model data are labeled. It's being used to improve the accuracy of the ML based on the existing input. EX: Image , Text.
challenges of ML: Data Collection and training the model.

Two major applications of Data Science - Weather forecasting : by analysing the previous weather data we can predict and prepare for the upcoming weather. - Stock price prediction : by learning about the stock price pattern over time we can predict the stock price in the future and join into the market on the right time.

Structured Data - all the data is labeled - all data have its corresponding data type - ready to used as ML model Semi structured Data - all the data is not categorized yet - still have null or missing value - not effrecint for training yet.
Outlier detection is the process of separating odd data in order to improve the accuracy of model and decrease the scale of data.
Data pre processing is the process of getting rid of unusable data such null valere , cleansing and normalizing the data in order to make the model much more efficient of for training.
K in K-means represent the number of data point.

Limitations: This is a small exploratory sample and is not production approval evidence.
The scored real-paper corpus is English university material, not Japanese cram-school material.
Only 14 nonblank short answers have explicit teacher item scores.
The source CSV MCQ totals conflict with answer-key-derived totals for Student_18 and Student_19, so MCQ aggregate totals are excluded.
The Japanese sheet uses a handwriting-style font rather than genuine student handwriting.
All semantic short-answer proposals remain teacher-review-only in Ooki Grader.
